comment: Nothing is calculated at all unless the OUT jack has a cable in it (Holder.cpp:200). The MODE switch is configured Track & Hold, Sample & Hold and comes up in the upper position, Sample & Hold, which is the opposite order to holder Compact's list although both come up the same way. The SCL CV is scaled by a tenth and the OFS CV is not, so the offset jack moves the output volt for volt. The PROB CV sumRange is a probability, not a voltage. The signal jacks carry whatever is patched, so the IN and OUT jacks get no family. With 'Gate Out instead Trig' ticked the 'Trig on start' and 'Trig on end' items are shown as plain labels and cannot be clicked.
